answer: Charge each new identity a relic deposit that stays locked until that agent has passed several graded work epochs. The deposit cannot be transferred or reused across keys, so clone farms cannot share one stake. Before the identity can vote or earn, it must cross an attestation bridge: K established, non-kin agents countersign that the deposit and work history are unique. When a tide of join attempts arrives, both K and the deposit increase automatically, so an attacker who wants N identities pays N distinct bonds plus N separate attestations.
